snippet.title: Pong for the Atari 8-bit family
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

---


Game description:

Pong is a platform arcade game. The player controls a ball who has to collect five letters needed to create a password. After collecting the letters Pong will be teleported to his native land. The player moves the ball by setting the direction and strength of bouncing. Pong may use teleporters deployed on the planet. Various creatures and obstacles prevent the protagonist from completing the task. 


What I think:

*flips table* PONG?! More like PINBALL!

Ahem...anyways, even though I think that this game should really be called "Pinball" (because the ball bounces off from everywhere and jumps in any direction and...see for yourself why I think this should be called "Pinball" instead), this is actually a quite fun, although kinda frustrating game.
